extracted.name: Tarragon Chicken and Rice Soup
extracted.description: Chicken and rice are simmered in a tarragon-infused broth creating a warm and comforting soup perfect for cold evenings.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon chicken soup base, or to taste
instruction_lines: Fill a Dutch oven or stockpot about 3/4 full with water; mix chicken base, tarragon, basil, and black pepper into water and bring to a boil. Cook chicken in the boiling broth mixture until no longer pink in the center, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove chicken from broth, leaving broth in Dutch oven to simmer. Dice chicken and add it back to the simmering broth.
Mix rice, onion, carrot, celery, and garlic into simmering broth; cook until rice is tender and soup is thickened, 25 to 30 minutes. Add more water if needed.
